text: I received the email regarding my Citi bank Checking account closure on XXXX In the letter said that my account will be closed next 60 days, and all funds belong me will be sent by check to my mailing address. I have funds on my account about {$16000.00}. After 60 days, I contacted couple times with number that provided on the letter to Citi Bank Froud department. They didn't provide any information. Only thing they said is, that they will contact to backoffice team and find out what is going on. They have never explain the reason of closure and they haven't sent my funds. At the date of writing this letter we already passed 5 months, and I still haven't received my funds.
